THE WORKFLOW

A specific job, end to end.

01

Start with field evidence

Keep the confirmation source and repair record distinct from a suspected alert.

02

Check comparability

Align periods and units, document demand changes and show missing observations.

03

Publish the caveats

Export source-linked evidence with reviewer sign-off. Observed differences alone do not prove causal savings.

QUESTIONS

Leak Report in context.

Is the report regulator certified?+

No. “Ready for review” means organized against an agreed requirement. The utility and its appropriate reviewers determine suitability.

What data does an evaluation need?+

A named data owner should review AMI licensing, flow/pressure availability, billing quality and GIS boundaries. Real records require procurement, legal and data-sharing permission before use.

Who owns field decisions?+

The utility sponsor, operations director and crew supervisor. LeakEvidence supplies proposed read-only decision support; there are no physical controls, dispatch or automated writeback.
